units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王是源氏之弟。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo was Genji's younger brother.

units.source_text: 源氏冒认玉鬘为亲女，则兵部卿应是玉鬘之叔父，

en.t: Since Genji falsely acknowledged Tamakazura as his own daughter, Prince Hyobukyo would be Tamakazura's uncle,

units.source_text: 所以下面的诗中言“血缘太近”。

en.t: and that is why the poem below says that their blood relationship is too close.
